name: jarvis-voice
description: Talk to Copilot Chat with Whistle (STT) and hear it reply with Chatterbox Nano (TTS), all running locally.

chatParticipants.name: jarvis
chatParticipants.description: Speak to Copilot and hear the answer

commands.name: talk
commands.description: Listen to the microphone and answer out loud

jarvis.serverDir.description: Folder containing server.py and .venv. Empty = the folder above this extension (D:\Jarvis).

jarvis.handsFree.description: After Jarvis finishes speaking a voice reply, start listening again automatically (say nothing to end).

jarvis.speakTypedPrompts.description: Also read replies aloud when you type to @jarvis instead of speaking.
